output_list.criticism: The mintToken function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that the vulnerability allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value, causing a denial of service to the user.
The transfer function has a wrong logic in it. The _transfer function allows the sender to transfer tokens to any address, including 0x0, causing a loss of funds.
The burnFrom function has an integer overflow vulnerability. The issue is that it allows users to burn more tokens than they have, causing a denial of service to the user.

The selfdestructs function has a typo in it, causing it to be non-functional. The correct function should be selfdestruct, but it is misspelled as selfdestructs, making it impossible to delete the contract.

The getEth function has a bad randomness, allowing the owner to steal funds from the user. The issue is that it allows the owner to withdraw any amount of ether from the user, causing a loss of funds.
